q: How do I count a site we started or bought partway through the year?
title: Counting a site added mid-year
short: Count its emissions from the day it came under your control, using its own bills from that date. If you bought a running site, decide with your base-year policy whether to add its past emissions to the base year. Note the start date and keep the deed, lease or commissioning record.
audience: Growing MSMEs adding units or warehouses

ul: Purchase or lease date, or commissioning date.
First fuel and power bills in your name.

p: A newly built site does not change the base year. A bought site with past emissions may, if it crosses your significance threshold.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure tied to its invoice, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any number back to the document it came from.
